title: Identica-ChatBlocker
description: Addon-plugin for Identica that blocks chat messages during authentication.
body:
Addon-plugin for [Identica](https://modrinth.com/plugin/identica) that blocks chat messages during authentication.

### Requirements

* **Identica:** 3.0.0+
* **Dependencies:** [packetevents](https://modrinth.com/plugin/packetevents) 2.12.2
* **Platforms:** Velocity, BungeeCord

### Installation

1. Download the latest version of Identica-ChatBlocker from [Versions](https://modrinth.com/plugin/identica-chatblocker/versions).
2. Place the .jar file into the plugins folder.
3. Restart the server to generate the configuration and necessary files.
